overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the March 23 minutes substantially complied with the accuracy requirement, and the missing document list was cured by approval subject to amendment on May 2.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the March 23 minutes failed to adequately summarize public comments on the track/artificial turf CPA funding hearing.
Complaint alleged the March 23 minutes did not include a list of documents the Committee used during the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Here, where the Committee voted on May 2 to approve the minutes subject to the addition of a list of documents used, we find that the Committee complied with the Open Meeting Law.
